verification_notes.note: Revised to remove unsupported specific EUR plan deviation figures (net profit EUR 1.6m below plan, etc.). Replaced with qualitative assessment 'slightly below plan' directly sourced from Financial Summary, supplemented with directional indicators ('deposits below target, loan growth above target for LHV Pank; LHV Bank (UK) loan book below plan') based on subsidiary section commentary. This ensures factual support while maintaining material relevance.

Removed unsupported claim 'introduced Smart-ID+ service' as no mention exists in source report. Retained operationally strategic developments (cloud migration, MiCA licence, name change, employer recognition) which are explicitly detailed in LHV Pank overview section.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses a distinct material theme: Q2 headline performance (K1), H1 performance (K2), balance sheet position and ratios (K3), performance vs plan (K4), subsidiary results (K5), strategic operational developments (K6), and impairment/portfolio quality (K7). No unit evaluates the same core content as another.

key_information_units.information: Q2 2026 headline financial performance: net profit EUR 24.7 million (+25% quarter-on-quarter, -20% year-on-year), net income EUR 79.0 million (+7% QoQ, +7% YoY), net interest income EUR 62.5 million (+5% QoQ, +8% YoY), net fee and commission income EUR 14.6 million, operating expenses EUR 43.6 million (-4% QoQ, +8% YoY), return on equity 13.1%, cost/income ratio 55.2%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary section and condensed income statement tables (pages 4, 18-19).

key_information_units.information: First six months 2026 financial performance: net profit EUR 44.4 million (-26% YoY), net income EUR 152.7 million (+2% YoY), net interest income EUR 121.8 million (+2% YoY), net fee and commission income EUR 29.3 million (-1% YoY), operating expenses EUR 89.2 million (+14% YoY), loan impairment charges EUR 7.1 million (compared to EUR 1.5 million in H1 2025), return on equity 11.7%, cost/income ratio 58.4%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Six-month columns in condensed income statement tables (pages 18-19).

key_information_units.information: Balance sheet position as at 30 June 2026: total assets EUR 9.65 billion, loan portfolio EUR 5.77 billion (+3% QoQ, +15% YoY), customer deposits EUR 7.56 billion (-3% QoQ, +3% YoY), equity EUR 758 million, CET1 ratio 15.8%, Tier 1 ratio 17.5%, capital adequacy ratio 20.8%, liquidity coverage ratio 171%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Condensed Statement of Financial Position (page 19) and liquidity section (page 10).

key_information_units.information: First half 2026 performance was slightly below management expectations as noted in the Financial Summary; deposits volumes were below target for LHV Pank while loan portfolio growth exceeded target, whereas LHV Bank (UK) loan book was below plan.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary stating results 'slightly weaker than planned' (page 4), with subsidiary-specific plan variance indications in LHV Pank overview (deposits below plan, loans above plan) and LHV Bank (UK) overview (loan book below plan) (pages 13-15).

key_information_units.information: Subsidiary performance: LHV Pank net profit EUR 24.3 million (up 20% QoQ), loan portfolio growth EUR 114 million, deposits decline EUR 312 million; LHV Bank (UK) net profit EUR 1.4 million (up 12% QoQ), loan book EUR 945 million; LHV Varahaldus net profit EUR 0.4 million, assets under management EUR 1.79 billion; LHV Kindlustus net profit EUR 0.8 million, gross premiums EUR 11.7 million.

Major operational and strategic developments: LHV Pank migrated core banking systems to Amazon Web Services cloud environment, received MiCA crypto-asset service provider licence, commenced process to change business name to LHV Bank AS, and was recognised as best Estonian employer in financial sector.

Loan impairment and portfolio quality: loan impairment charges increased to EUR 5.8 million in Q2 2026 (from EUR 1.3 million in Q1 2026), driven by forward-looking model provisions; loan portfolio collateral fair value exceeds book value by 3%; credit quality remains strong with low non-performing loan ratios.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary and credit quality section (pages 4, 12-13).
